title: Royalton Negril workers’ 21 October workplace protest
reason: Excluded from the coded event set on current evidence: the public protest and reported crowd of more than 200 meet public-gathering and size indicators, but the article describes demands to the hotel management (work conditions, low wages, food/water, hours, and removal of the general manager). The Tourism Ministry’s later involvement and Labour Ministry’s preliminary action are follow-up responses, not evidence that the gathering itself demanded action from the Jamaican state or state policy. The state-target requirement is not established.
notes: Keep distinct from later November hotel workplace actions. Publication 23 October; the report places the action on Monday 21 October. Do not use the ministerial meeting as proof of an original state target.

start_date.summary: Report says staff withdrew services Monday, National Heroes Day; in 2024 this was 21 October, and article was published 23 October.

location.summary: Royalton Negril, Westmoreland; source identifies the property and Western Bureau.

participants_original.summary: More than 200 workers, as reported by Gleaner.

demand_target.summary: Article attributes complaints and removal demand to hotel management; no protester demand directed to Government is reported.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: More than 200 workers reported in the gathering, exceeding 50; count is distinct from a total workforce count.
